spans.text: A MADHAVI
madhavi.aradhyula03@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/madhavi-av-a3ba34b0
Role: Business Analyst
Professional Summary
Results-driven professional with 8 years of experience in business analysis, product ownership, and quality assurance
within the digital payments industry. Hands-on exposure to requirement gathering, writing user stories, acceptance
criteria, and functional documentation (BRD/FSD). Experienced in collaborating with stakeholders and technical teams
to support gap analysis, process flows, and payment system implementations. Currently enhancing BA expertise while
leveraging strong payments domain knowledge and Agile/Scrum experience to bridge business and technology needs
effectively. Experienced in digital payments systems, including cards (ATM & POS),Tokenization, IMPS, UPI, AEPS, NEFT,
RTGS, SWIFT, and cross-border payment solutions, with hands-on knowledge of transaction flows, clearing and
Settlement.
Key Competencies
- Business Analysis & Requirement Gathering
BRD/FSD Documentation and Writing User Stories
Stakeholder & Vendor Management
Process Modelling (AS-IS / TO-BE)
Agile & Scrum (CSPO Certified)
Payment Switch Migration
Regulatory & Compliance Requirements
Product Ownership & Backlog Management
Technical Skills
- Operating Systems: Linux, Windows
Testing Tools: FINSIM, BOSS, MSGSIM, T3, Postman
Databases: Oracle, Postgres, Redis,Cassandra
Messaging Queues: Kafka
Payment Switches: IST Switch, Bharat Switch, Nexus
Defect Tracking Tools: JIRA, ALM, Excel
Web Servers : Apache Tomcat9, Nginx
Collabration Tools : Confluence, Teams
BPMN Tools : Draw.io, MS Visio
Professional Experience
Company : Tech Mahindra | Business Analyst cum UAT Tester
Duration: Aug 2022 – Present | Location: Hyderabad| Client: Mastercard | Project: SMT-Validator
and Mastercard Nexus Switch Migration
Key Responsibilities:
Gathered, analyzed, and documented business requirements.
Converted requirements into user stories, Prepared functional workflows.
Executed test plans and validated transaction processing across payment systems for Authorization flows which
includes ATM,POS,MDES transactions.
Supported QA and Regression team for testing after each build deployment.
Facilitated defect triage sessions with development teams.
Provided daily test execution status updates to senior management.
Participate in Scrum meetings and backlog grooming.
Worked on Cross Border Payments for Cards and Non-Card based Payments.
Trained new hires on Payment Switch Migration Flows.
Worked on Payment Rails like Cards, SWIFT (MT103,MT202,MT202COV).
Company : Pine Labs | Sr QA Cum Product Owner
Duration: Jan 2022 – June 2022 | Location: Hyderabad | Project: PayLater Mastercard Installments (BNPL)
Key Responsibilities:
Owned product backlog and prioritized features based on business needs.
Collaborated with development teams to define functional specifications.
Led end-to-end integration testing for BNPL solutions.
Managed stakeholder expectations and communication.
Oversaw UAT and production deployment.
Conducted root cause analysis on production issues.
Company : Capgemini | Consultant
Duration: May 2021 – Dec 2021 | Location: Hyderabad | Project: Core Banking & Retail Processing System
Key Responsibilities:
Gathered and analyzed business requirements, translating them into BRDs, FSDs, user stories, and acceptance
criteria for core banking modules and retail payment workflows.
Conducted gap analysis, impact assessments, and process mapping to support system modernization and
compliance initiatives.
Collaborated with technical teams, business stakeholders, and third-party vendors to ensure accurate requirement
translation and solution alignment.
Assisted in UAT, functional testing, and validation of transactions across SWIFT MT103,MT202,MT202COV, NEFT,
and RTGS payment systems.
Created process diagrams, flowcharts, and documentation to communicate workflows, system changes, and
technical designs effectively.
Company : National Payments Corporation of India | Senior Associate
Duration: Jan 2017 – May 2021 | Location: Hyderabad
Key Projects:
Upgradation of AEPS Services from V2.0 to V2.5
IMPS Service Migration from IST to Bharat Switch(UPI Common Code)
Integration of FRM Module
Migration of Payment Switch from ITM to IST
Implementation of LM Service for ATM, IMPS, and AEPS
Implementation of Fraud Detection system
Certification Testing with member banks
Worked on Tag Mapping to Element level mapping for IMPS.
Key Responsibilities:
Gathered, analyzed, and documented business, functional, and technical requirements for payment switch
migration projects.
Performed gap analysis between legacy and new payment switch systems to identify discrepancies.
Designed AS-IS and TO-BE process flows for transaction authorization, routing, clearing, settlement, and
reconciliation.
Defined business rules for transaction life-cycles, authorization, clearing, and settlement work
flows.
Supported payment gateway integration's, API-based solutions, and fraud detection mechanisms.
Conducted load and stress testing to validate switch performance under peak transaction volumes.
Coordinated production environment setup and facilitated handover sessions with production teams during switch
migration.
Collaborated with vendors to clarify requirements, ensuring on-time delivery of system integration's.
Designed and executed functional and integration test cases, validating ISO8583 message formats and end-to-end
flows.
Managed defects using JIRA and Excel, ensuring timely resolution and retesting.
Provided post-migration support by monitoring transaction success rates, system performance, and error handling.
Conducted root cause analysis (RCA) on production issues, implementing corrective actions.
Worked on IMPS migration from ISO8583 protocol to ISO20022 XML protocol(similar).
Acted as a liaison with banks, resolving technical queries and suggesting improvements for product efficiency.
Certifications
- Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), 2025
Fundamentals of SWIFT MT & ISO20022 – MVLCO, 2020
Trained in Embedded Systems – Vector India, 2016
Education
Bachelor of Engineering in ECE – Gayatri Vidya Parishad, Andhra University, Visakhapatnam, India (2015)
Hobbies
Reading Books, Writing blogs
